assessments.title: Week 2 • Multi-step equations formative practice
assessments.instructions: Show equivalent steps, original-equation checks, and units. 1 (5 points): Solve (2x+1)/3=5 and check. 2 (5 points): Rearrange d=rt for t, including the restriction on r. 3 (5 points): Solve 3(x-2)=2x+7 and verify. 4 (5 points): A club has $74 for a $18 setup fee plus $7 per visitor. Write and solve the equation, state units and check feasibility.

rubricCriteria.label: Literal formula and restriction
rubricCriteria.description: t=d/r, r≠0, with algebraic isolation explained.

assessments.title: Week 2 • Individual mastery checkpoint
assessments.instructions: Independent written checkpoint. Show steps and verify in the original equation. 1 (5 points): Solve (x−1)/3=(2x+1)/5. 2 (5 points): Solve 3(2x−4)=4x+10. 3 (5 points): Classify 5(x+2)−3=5x+7 as one, none or infinitely many solutions and justify. 4 (5 points): Rearrange F=(9/5)C+32 to solve for C. 5 (5 points): Rearrange A=bh/2 to solve for b; state restrictions. 6 (5 points): A bus holds 18 students. How many buses are needed for 50 students? Write an inequality and explain the minimum whole number.

rubricCriteria.label: Rational equation
rubricCriteria.description: x=−8; multiplication of both sides and original check.
